svg.aria-label: Fig. L4 Return prediction lineage: the call return stack beside the M1 return stack
svg.text: Fig. L4 Return prediction lineage: the call return stack beside the M1 return stack
Left: the stack as Kaeli and Emma 1991 describe it, from the text; the repair scheme of Skadron 1998 waits for the paper. Right: the M1 return stack from the measurements.
Kaeli and Emma 1991, from the text; no figure
return targets move, the table mispredicts them
target from the stack, not a table
returns in their own fetch table
Plausible: a stack is generic; two levels
and the PAC check are Apple's
the PAC rides in the high bits
checked where the stack pushes and pops
refilled on the way back up
a predicted return is a lookup
